snippet.title: Aloft - Gliders & Gales Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Soar with style in the new Gliders & Gales Update! Earn new rewards in race-style challenges to personalise your gliders with 22 new glider patterns, 6 new glider shapes, 2 new glider fabric upgrades, 9 new glider Oculi with unique bonuses, and 6+ glider trails—all customisable through the glider stand! Mix and match to make gliders truly your own. 

Play Aloft on Steam Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1660080/Aloft/

Soar the skies in Aloft, the co-op sandbox survival game set in a world of floating islands. Build any island into a skyship, your home in the clouds. Find lost knowledge, cure the fungal corruption, and brave the hurricane to restore the ecosystem.

#Aloft #survivalgame #cozygames 

Join us in the skies
